title: Implement _eval_derivative_n_times for sin class
description: Add the _eval_derivative_n_times method to the sin class. The method signature is def _eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n): where s is the symbol being differentiated with respect to and n is the number of derivatives. Implementation should check if n.is_Integer and n.is_nonnegative, and if self.args[0] equals s, then return sin(self.args[0] + n*pi/2). Otherwise return None to fall back to default repeated differentiation.
expected_output: Python method with signature def _eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n): within the sin class that returns sin(self.args[0] + n*pi/2) when conditions are met, or None otherwise.
